settings.editor: Community is the present. Youth and education are the next. Ideas are the foundation beneath both. Research and advocacy run through all three.
Strengthening communities through collaboration and shared purpose.
Empowering young people with knowledge, skills and confidence.
Championing ideas that inform, inspire and create impact.
Turning evidence into policy, and policy into change on the ground.

settings.title: THE SPINE, NOT A FOURTH PILLAR

settings.editor: Research generates the evidence. Advocacy carries it to change. Policy briefs, surveys, round tables and parliamentary engagement cut across all three pillars.
